no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held for this application.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for the KANUMA (sebelipase alfa) BLA 125561. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review states there were no decisional issues that required input from an advisory committee, and the Office Director memo explains the application was not referred because the safety profile was acceptable for treating lysosomal acid lipase deficiency and raised no significant unexpected safety or efficacy issues for a biologic of this class. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
